issues.title: Ingest the Scottsdale budget
issues.learned: FY2025-26 all funds $2.20B — the Capital plan ($974M) and General Fund ($652M) are the biggest pieces. Police is the largest GF department (FY26 inflated by a one-time ~$50M pension paydown). Foots to the dollar.
